We need to compute probability that a flagged device is infected given data.

We have batch of 100 devices, 20 infected, 80 uninfected.

Scanner detects 18 of the 20 infected => true positives = 18. So 2 infected missed (false negatives).

It also flags 16 uninfected devices => false positives = 16. So among uninfected (80), 16 flagged, 64 not flagged.

Total flagged devices = true positives (18) + false positives (16) = 34 flagged.

Probability that a randomly chosen flagged device is infected = 18/34 = 9/17.

Thus answer is 9/17 => option B.

We need reply with A or B only on final line. So final line "B".
